activity.message:
Add the profile README

The page shown at the top of github.com/kosuke-satake: Robotics first, then
Web, Apps, Sandbox and an activity dashboard. Apps and Sandbox only point to
their organizations, which are the main place for them.

The graphics are generated by the scripts in scripts/ (rover roadmap,
architecture diagram, dashboard), so the numbers come from the repositories
themselves. The two web demo screenshots are captured from the live demo
sites. Nothing on the page is served by a third party.

ci: drop the unused Setup Pages step

actions/configure-pages reads the Pages site's base URL and configures static
site generators such as Next.js and Nuxt. This site is plain HTML and uses
none of its outputs. The step also reads the Pages API, which the build job
does not have permission for now that its permissions are limited to what it
needs, so it could only add a failure.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 Extra <noreply@anthropic.com>

docs(readme): describe the data flow, checks, AI assistance and the license

The README did not say what the workflow publishes, why the daily data commit
is made by the Actions bot, or how to recover when GitHub disables the
scheduled workflow after 60 idle days. Document those, the checks, a plain
statement that the dashboard was first generated with Gemini and has been
reworked with Claude Code, and the license.

Use the workspace branch prefixes (feat/, fix/, refactor/) instead of
feature/, bugfix/ and chore/, so the README and the workspace rules agree.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 Extra <noreply@anthropic.com>

chore: add editor settings and agent instruction files

Add .editorconfig and .gitattributes from the workspace template, and an
AGENTS.md that records the stack, the file-by-file architecture, the commands
and the constraints a new session needs. The main one: the daily data commit
must stay under the Actions bot identity, or it fills the owner's
contribution graph again. CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md only import AGENTS.md.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 Extra <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(data): leave bot commits out of Recent Activity

The daily data commit made by GitHub Actions, and commits by agents such as
Jules, are not the owner's activity, but they filled the Recent Activity
list: 10 of its 15 entries were data updates. Ask the API for each commit's
author name and skip names that end in "[bot]".

The script ran on import, which made the filter impossible to test. Read the
token inside the fetch function and run it only when the file is executed
directly. Add unit tests for the filter with `node --test` (no dependency)
and run them in the workflow before fetching.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 Extra <noreply@anthropic.com>
